## Naming Conventions
- Backend module folders under `backend/packages/` use kebab-case package names (`access-profile`, `campus-administration`, `hosting-lifecycle`, `discovery-participation`, `notifications-system-flow`, `safety-moderation`).
- Backend source files under `src/controllers`, `src/services`, `src/repositories`, and `src/entities` use PascalCase filenames that mirror the main class or service name.
- Backend tests mirror the unit under test with a `.test.ts` suffix inside `src/__tests__/`.
- Mobile screen files under `mobile/src/screens/` use PascalCase names ending in `Screen.tsx` and map directly to React Navigation route names.
- Mobile navigation lives under `mobile/src/navigation/`, while API helpers live under `mobile/src/services/`.
- Documentation files in `docs/` use lowercase kebab-case names for contracts, while `Documentation/` keeps source-planning artifacts with verbose human-readable names and version suffixes like `v1.1` or `v1.2`.
- Placeholder `.gitkeep` files mark intentionally empty folders meant to receive future code.

## Path Rules
- Root `package.json` declares an npm workspaces monorepo with `backend` and `mobile` as the only workspaces.
- No TypeScript `baseUrl` or `paths` aliases are configured in either `backend/tsconfig.json` or `mobile/tsconfig.json`; project code uses relative imports throughout.
- Backend TypeScript compiles CommonJS output into `backend/dist/` with `rootDir` set to `./` and decorators enabled for TypeORM entities.
- Mobile TypeScript extends `expo/tsconfig.base`, uses `moduleResolution: Bundler`, and resolves local modules relatively from `mobile/App.tsx` and `mobile/src/**`.
- `mobile/babel.config.js` only applies `babel-preset-expo`, so there are no custom Babel import aliases.
- Backend module composition happens centrally in `backend/src/app.ts`, which imports route factories from each package via relative paths like `../packages/<module>/src/routes`.
